title: Autonomous excited-state characterization of two Ir(III) arylacetylides
difficulty_reasons: The molecular systems and observables are fixed, but the Agent must select and justify a defensible method and discriminate triplet state-character interpretations.
Two complexes require independent validation of geometry, state ordering, and localization evidence.

data.description: Complete SI geometries: H 65 atoms/C31H23N6F4Ir; CN 66 atoms/C32H22N7F4Ir.

required_deliverables.description: Validated per-complex energies, orbital assignments, evidence, conclusion, and bounded-failure information.
